description: The MEV order flow stream PUSHED to your https URL for one chain: one signed message per completed minute with detected MEV on that chain, each carrying the per-pool rows of that minute (the same rows as mev_pressure). 4 dollars buys 7 days of one chain (bnb, ethereum, polygon or avalanche); call once per chain, and again to renew. Manage with webhook_status and webhook_unregister; the contract is in mev_flow_spec. Price: 4 dollars per call. A ChainHelix API key does not cover this tool.

chain.description: One chain: bnb, ethereum, polygon or avalanche. Example: bnb

url.description: https URL on a public host name, up to 500 characters; localhost, .local, .internal and .lan names, private IPv4 addresses and IPv6 literals are refused. Example: https://example.com/hooks/chainhelix

name: stream_register

dataGaps.description: Present only when the window of the answer overlaps a recorded data gap. Figures inside each listed period are incomplete. periods are the recorded gaps (end null while still open); atCall is measured against the window of this call and is left out of meta.contentHash.
